description: Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - The Subscriber SIM  Cards Regulations, No. 01 of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, establishing new regulatory requirements for SIM card registration. It creates a legal framework and compliance requirements for telecommunications operators, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While the President is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about establishing statutory regulations under existing legislation.
